headline: New draft agent guide for adopting Future Defaults
summary: Adds a draft markdown guide the upgrade CLI copies for agents handling Future Defaults adoption, with or without a version update. It is instruction text for an agent and does not change compiled code, so a short read is enough.
reason: New draft docs file that only guides an agent when the CLI copies it; no executable code changes, though it steers agent actions.
risk_signals: agent instruction text steers automated repo changes
